profile.headline: Lead Software Engineer at State Farm ®
profile.summary:
• Nearly 10 years of experience in data analysis and data visualizations
• Hands-on experience with a wide variety of business intelligence and data extraction tools i.e. Business Objects, SAS
• Experience in UX design using Sketch and Adobe Illustrator
• Extensive experience in MS office suite 
• Proficient in using Tableau and Qlikview to visualize datasets in the form of interactive worksheets and dashboards
• Driven self-starter with a strong work ethic
• Extremely detail-oriented
• Outstanding organizational skills and effective time manager
• Excellent communicator, both written & verbal
• Excellent ability to work independently as well as in a team

positions.title: Lead Software Engineer
positions.description:
•Led and mentored other software engineers and collaborated with other dev leads to drive out the technical and software designs of our GitLab, Scalr and AWS environments.
•Served as AWS account administrator for entire DASDI suite, while continually identifying opportunities to improve and develop automation to enable new capabilities.
•Managed multiple AWS account budgets, tracked anomalies and mitigated all DNR’s, resulting in enhanced security and significant cost savings.
•Hosted FinOps sessions with engineering and analytic teams to establish effective budgeting processes, monitor cloud expenditures, and drive financial accountability across departments, leading to a 55% reduction in our cloud costs.
•Established AWS core infrastructure patterns for AWS Infra management by creating and modifying individual roles to each team, which helped enhance the data security and ease of use while adhering to least privilege.
•Streamlined teams work intake process which increases line of sight into other engineers work and allows direct communication with the requestor.
•Designed and developed scalable applications on AWS and custom dashboards that enable data-driven decisions to be made.
•Maintain high quality software development standards through thorough testing consisting of automated end-to-end product testing, code scans, etc...
•Deliver mature products to production environments using continuous delivery, GitOps, and the DevOps process as well as mentored and grew teams’ knowledge in application coding best practices.
•Enable innovative data visualization and data automation solutions, which allows business partners to focus on their business goals, KPI’s and OKR’s, without having to pause and figure out how to visualize and automate data.

positions.title: Data Analyst
positions.description:
•Establish and maintain strategic partnerships with business stakeholders to optimize digital operations and overall business performance.
•Utilize database management software tools and data analytics tools to produce and distribute reporting across Enterprise Technology.
•Develop self-serve analytics solutions using Business Intelligence tools that produce insights that allow for quick, data-driven decisions to be made.
•Design multiple web-based dashboards that utilize a custom framework with an audience reach of nearly 2,000 users across the enterprise, easily allowing users to gather insights and make data-driven decisions.
•Automated data with the use of effective shell scripting and SQL queries, saving analysts hours of time and effort compared to manually running these ad-hoc processes individually.
•Developed automation patterns for dashboard refresh processes, condensing a week-long process that involved multiple Coordinators down to an hour, while improving the quality of the end deliverables
•Conduct on-going research into industry news/challenges and customer-centric tools/technologies to better serve and partner with those making insights-driven decisions.

positions.title: Analyst - Digital Analytics
positions.description:
•Drive business decisions by providing quantitative and qualitative data analysis and reporting of patterns, insights, and trends to decision-makers. Collect, aggregate, and analyze data from multiple internal and external sources to drive insights into business performance.
•Oversee the support, prioritization, and execution of State Farm digital initiatives, ensuring effective reporting and performance measurement.
•Gather inputs, assess outcomes, and provide detailed Key Performance Indicator (KPI) reports.
•Define objectives, develop performance estimates, and monitor progress against established goals.
•Assist Product Managers and Product Owners by offering data-driven recommendations to enhance decision-making.
•Leverage analytical and quantitative expertise to validate hypotheses, refine assumptions, generate insights, and evaluate success through data-driven methodologies.
•Develop comprehensive reports and dashboards utilizing industry-leading data visualization tools, including QlikView that guide and influence business decisions by interpreting key metrics and performance data.
•Collaborate with Enterprise Technology teams to identify, capture, and manage essential tracking data.
•Conducted A/B testing, interpret findings, and perform pre- and post-analysis to drive continuous improvement for the new SF.com billing page.

positions.title: Business Intelligence Analyst
positions.description:
•Handled ad hoc requests for insights that require complex query filtering techniques using BI tools and in-depth knowledge of relational databases and the ability to communicate observations and recommendations clearly.
•Produced Tableau visualizations to managers and directors that delivered historical and current insights for which data-driven decisions can be made.
•Conducted on-going research into industry news/challenges and customer-centric tools/technologies to better serve and partner with those making insights-driven decisions.
•Served as a testing analyst for a new in-house developed underwriting system, executing multiple A/B tests collaborating with cross-functional teams to implement insights and refine strategies for enhanced agent and customer experience.
•Participated in the greater analytics community at COUNTRY through “Hack Day’s” and regular “analytic huddles” in order to build/strengthen a network of like-minded professionals, foster new ideas, and openly collaborate on projects that will lead to revenue gains, operational efficiencies, and cost reductions.
